name: discordia-harp-of-malice-rest-applies-level-swap-with-music-counter-x
notes: Discordia, Harp of Malice REST: -X level on the target champion and +X on yours, X = its music counters (2). Pre-fix the effects were named without X (undefined $musicCount).

rulesClauses: [REST]: Target champion gets -X level and your champion gets +X level until end of turn, where X is the amount of music counters on CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Discordia, Harp of Malice: the generated handler ($musicCount) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
